_help: Questions asked when a caller lodges a complaint (after registration / PIN check).
Answers are saved in the complaints table, column details (JSON), under 'key'.
Edit freely; restart the bot to apply. Same format as registration_questions.json.
type: 'free'   -> the caller's own words, kept as said (use for descriptions)
type: 'text'   -> a short answer the LLM extracts (a name, a city, a product)
type: 'digits' -> spoken or typed on the keypad (# to finish); min_len / max_len
type: 'choice' -> one of 'options' (the LLM maps the reply to one of them)
required: false lets the caller say 'skip'.

ask.en: What is the complaint about? For example an order, delivery, payment, product quality, or customer service.
ask.hi: शिकायत किस बारे में है? जैसे ऑर्डर, डिलीवरी, पेमेंट, प्रोडक्ट की क्वालिटी, या कस्टमर सर्विस।

ask.en: If you have an order number, say it or type it and press hash. Otherwise say skip.
ask.hi: अगर आपके पास ऑर्डर नंबर है, तो बोलिए या टाइप करके हैश दबाइए। नहीं तो स्किप बोलिए।

ask.en: Please describe the problem in a few sentences.
ask.hi: कृपया कुछ वाक्यों में समस्या बताइए।
